scope.daylight_saving_boundary_note: America/New_York reverted from EDT UTC-04 to EST UTC-05 at 02:00 local Nov1. Scheduled local midnight-to-noon span is 13 elapsed hours, not 12; retained contiguous local schedule boundaries without losing repeated 01:00 hour. A strict elapsed-12h interpretation would begin 01:00 EDT and omit first scheduled hour.
scope.source_publication_rule: Occurrence, original publication, collection, and evidence horizon preserved separately. In-window disclosure of pre-window occurrence is not a new in-window attack. Later edits cannot retroactively change horizon.

new_events.summary: Nakilat disclosed that LNG carrier Al Mayeda/Al Mayedah was struck by unidentified objects while underway in Arabian Gulf Friday evening. Company reports no crew injuries, no environmental impact and vessel safe and operational; impact assessment ongoing. Occurrence predates window, first company disclosure is in-window. No attacker, weapon, hull damage extent or precise coordinates established.

Reuters Sunday Gulf market report: Saudi TASI -0.8% and Qatar QSI +4.6% in source observation; index times and later revisions require provider reconciliation. This is equity market reporting, not direct causal proof of Iran war pricing.

Nakilat says Al Mayeda safe and operational after Friday unidentified-object strike; no injury/environmental impact reported. Does not establish no cargo loss or final repair cost; no fleet-wide LNG disruption quantified.
